name: Kurayami Zaka no Ie
source:
Afterwar Tokyo. A hill called "dark slope". There is an old house where the master is missing for 18 years. Women in the house still know nothing of his mysterious disappearance. 
That is the beginning of the story.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
